{{Quote|Greetings citizen. What brings you to this exclusive retreat at which you probably have no legitimate business?|Imperial pilot stationed at the Emperor's Retreat|<ref name="SWG:CC">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=heroic|Corellian Corvette}}</ref>}}
The '''Emperor's Retreat''' was [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] private sanctuary on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. West of the city of [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]], the retreat was a luxurious marble edifice nestled in the Naboo hills, overlooking a [[lake]]. Palpatine attended his retreat with much of his court, including his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], Head [[Chamberlain/Legends|Chamberlain]] [[Kaja Or'Zee]], [[Grand Inquisitor/Legends|Grand Inquisitor]] [[Ja'ce Yiaso]], [[Chief Inquisitor]] and head of security [[Loam Redge]], [[Procurator of Justice]] [[Hethrir]], and many others among the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adepts]] and [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]]. Under Redge's watch, the facility's security included a perimeter of guard towers, several [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transports]] and [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]], and many [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and other [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], including [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]] and [[Dark Trooper/Legends|dark troopers]].

Loam Redge oversaw construction of the site; upon the retreat's establishment, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] practically disappeared from Naboo and Palpatine had little trouble with them. However, this changed by [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], when a number of incidents occurred near the retreat, including an assassination attempt on [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Grayeg Wintozzen|Grayed Wintozzen]], a counterfeit operation, and an Imperial [[Dolman|captain]] being shot down in his [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. Palpatine reacted by creating a demonstration of the Empire's force, but problems still continued, when a traitor to the Empire started a campaign of sabotage that was only ended with his death.

==Description==
{{Quote|Enjoy your stay at our beloved Emperor's Retreat, Sir!|[[Naboo Space Station]]'s communication officer|<ref name="SWG:NSS">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other|Conversation with the Naboo Space Station}}</ref>}}
[[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] retreat was located on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It had been built out of a surprising affection of the Emperor for his ancestral homeworld. Palpatine visited the retreat when he wished to meditate<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref> and contemplate the future of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].<ref name="TCG">{{SWGTCG|set=Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|cardname=Emperor's Retreat}}</ref> The Emperor also held summits with personnel from the highest levels of the Galactic Empire there,<ref name="Tour">{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=60009|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Planet Tour}}</ref> and met with some of his most powerful [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|advisors]].<ref name="WW">{{InsiderCite|65|Who's Who in Star Wars Galaxies|Who's Who in ''Star Wars'' Galaxies}}</ref>

[[File:Retreat.jpg|thumb|left|280px|Palpatine's retreat and shuttle.]]
The Emperor's Retreat was a heavily fortified complex<ref name="NoP" /> located west of the city of [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]].<ref name="SWG:ER" /> The structure sat among the hills of Naboo, overlooking a tranquil [[lake]].<ref name="TRoD">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Ruins of Dantooine]]''</ref> Leading to the retreat was a long and wide road, large enough to accommodate the Empire's [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]].<ref name="TCG" /> High walls<ref name="NoP" /> and guard towers surrounded the facility, and security patrols kept watch outside. Banners depicting the Imperial Crest insignia specifically utilized by the Emperor's Royal Guard were also adorned throughout various towers.<ref name="SWG:ER" /> The area was protected by a sophisticated security system designed by the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] that combined an extensive network of [[Holocamera/Legends|holocameras]], audio pickups, and [[Security scanner/Legends|scanners]].<ref name="NoP" /> [[Emperor's personal shuttle/Legends|Palpatine's personal shuttle]] was granted a landing pad to remain docked while the Emperor was there, with [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] standing by.<ref name="SWG:ER" /><ref name="TRoD" />

The retreat itself was a multi-story structure, styled with green-domed roofs<ref name="SWG:ER" /> built in the [[Classical Naboo style/Legends|typical Naboo baroque architecture]].<ref name="NoP" /> A wide stone concourse lined the backside of the building, with a balcony overlooking the lake. The retreat's front was outfitted with a veranda.<ref name="SWG:ER" /> The retreat's interior was decorated luxuriously. The walls were made of a mottled pink and tan [[Marble/Legends|marble]], while the floors of its many hallways were covered with thick, [[Gold/Legends|gold]]-lined maroon carpeting.<ref name="TRoD" /> [[Computer/Legends|Computer]] terminals were scattered throughout the facility. Palpatine's inner sanctum was accessible by elevator, the entrance to which was guarded constantly by the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guards]].<ref name="SWG:ER" /><ref name="TRoD" /> The antechamber to his room was festooned with maroon-and-gold banners and lit with cylindrical gold lamps suspended from the ceiling.<ref name="TRoD" /> Within, Palpatine held audience from his dais.<ref name="SWG:ER" />

==Occupants==
Although he did not live permanently at the Retreat, the principal inhabitant was Palpatine, [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and Emperor of the Galactic Empire. While there, he was typically attended by a large collection of courtiers, hangers-on, Army and [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] officers, and high-level bureaucrats begging for advantages, positions or just a bit of the Emperor's attention.<ref name="NoP" /> Commanding from a dais in his sanctum, Palpatine held audience with those who were granted permission to see him.<ref name="SWG:TE">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|The Emperor|Naboo}}</ref> Access to the retreat, and ultimately to Palpatine, was controlled by the Emperor's Head [[Chamberlain/Legends|Chamberlain]], [[Kaja Or'Zee]].<ref name="SWG:KO">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Kaja Or'Zee|Naboo}}</ref> Those who wished to see Palpatine had to prove themselves worthy of an audience with him.<ref name="WW" /> Or'Zee attended to Palpatine,<ref name="Serving">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67382&month=082007|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Serving the Empire}}</ref> and saw that the business of the retreat ran smoothly.<ref name="WW" /> Along with Palpatine, his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] had his own chambers in the retreat. Vader saw to those who the Emperor had no personal use for, but could still be useful to the Empire.<ref name="SWG:DV">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Darth Vader|Naboo}}</ref><ref name="Serving" />

[[File:Emperor_Palpatine.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Emperor Palpatine at his private retreat.]]
Officials of the Empire's highest ranks and those close to Palpatine took up residence at the retreat as well. Many high-level members of the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]] could be found within its walls, including [[Grand Inquisitor/Legends|Grand Inquisitor]] [[Ja'ce Yiaso]],<ref name="SWG:II">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other|Imperial Inquisition}}</ref> [[Chief Inquisitor]] [[Loam Redge]],<ref name="SWG:ILR">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Inquisitor Loam Redge|Naboo}}</ref> Inquisitor [[Fa'Zoll]], and Inquisitor [[Vrke]].<ref name="SWG:II" /> Another member of the Empire's [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adepts]] that visited the retreat was [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Hethrir]], Imperial [[Procurator of Justice]].<ref name="SWG:LHPoJ">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Lord Hethrir, Procurator of Justice|Naboo}}</ref> Several ranking members of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] were sometimes stationed at the retreat, including the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]],<ref name="SWG:CT">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Captain Thrawn|Naboo}}</ref> [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]],<ref name="SWG:CV">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Colonel Veers|Naboo}}</ref> [[Wurson Harro]],<ref name="SWG:WH">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=conversation|Wurson Harro|Naboo}}</ref> [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Velso]],<ref name="SWG:CC" /> [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Barret Herand]],<ref name="SWG:IS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Imperial|Imperial Spy|Naboo}}</ref> and Lieutenant [[Allard Lissara]].<ref name="SWG:BIttER">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=faction|Imperial|Bring Information to the Emperor's Retreat|Naboo}}</ref> Officers as low as the rank of [[Major/Legends|major]] were assigned their own offices.<ref name="SWG:IS" />

Security for the site was charged to Loam Redge.<ref name="TCSWE" /> The retreat was heavily guarded.<ref name="Serving" /> A full [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] was garrisoned at the retreat at all times, along with armor units from the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].<ref name="NoP" /> Every stormtrooper at the retreat, including [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]], snipers, and even [[Dark Trooper/Legends|dark troopers]],<ref name="SWG:ER" /> was kept on high alert.<ref name="WW" /> Palpatine's sanctum was guarded by two Royal Guards at the elevator to the sanctum, whose job was to prevent [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] from getting in or the Emperor from being disturbed, while two more served the Emperor from aside his dais.<ref name="SWG:ER" /><ref name="WW" /> Darth Vader had an escort of two stormtrooper riflemen outside his own chambers. The entire facility was protected by a patrol of [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transports]]<ref name="SWG:ER" /> and the more heavy-duty All Terrain Armored Transports, and had an air patrol of [[TIE/Advanced starfighter]]s.<ref name="TCG" /> Aside from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], Naboo was the most heavily guarded planet in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="WW" />

The Emperor's Retreat, like many installations in the Empire, was filled with [[MSE-6 series repair droid/Legends|MSE-6 mouse droids]]; among the diminutive droids' duties was handling the retreat's housecleaning.<ref name="TRoD" /> [[RA-7 protocol droid/Legends|RA-7 protocol droids]] could be found on the grounds of the retreat as well.<ref name="SWG:ER" />

==History==
{{Quote|At last! The plans for the Emperor's Retreat! Princess Leia will be glad to see these.|[[Nura Tinall]]|<ref name="SWG:EQB">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Ebenn Q3 Baobab|Naboo}}</ref>}}
When Palpatine elected to build a private retreat, he chose his homeworld of Naboo, not because he felt any loyalty to the planet, but because his world's landscape&mdash;and the location of the retreat in particular&mdash;made for a soothing view.<ref name="TRoD" /> Palpatine assigned construction of the facility to Inquisitor Loam Redge.<ref name="TCSWE" /> The Emperor faced little trouble on Naboo after the retreat's establishment, and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] presence on the planet made itself practically invisible to the Empire.<ref name="TRoD" />

[[File:Retreat_Backside.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Emperor's Retreat, cliff side.]]
However, the year [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> saw a good deal of Rebel activity in the retreat's vicinity. Palpatine and his court took up residence in the retreat. That year, [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Grayeg Wintozzen|Grayed Wintozzen]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of a system near Naboo, visited the retreat to meet with other officials. A local Rebel group plotted to hire an assassin to murder Wintozzen, but after overhearing one of their conversations the Empire, with the help of a visiting Imperial loyalist, was able to take them out first, and the assassin and all conspirators were killed. Kaja Or'Zee wrote a letter of recommendation for the Empire's new ally, promising to put in a good word with the Emperor himself.<ref name="SWG:KO" /> The Imperials at the retreat saw many more victories over local Rebel movements that year. Chief Inquisitor Loam Redge had a group of Rebel sympathizers hauled in for questioning.<ref name="SWG:ILR" /> Lord Hethrir found a [[Forger (profession)/Legends|counterfeiter]] in league with the Rebels, and had him, his Rebel contact, and even the contact's father killed.<ref name="SWG:LHPoJ" />

The Rebels made trouble of their own, though. On approach to the retreat, Captain [[Dolman|Dolmen]] was shot down in his [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], and Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo had to send out a party to escort him to safety. Thrawn, as he was known, had the shuttle's transponder retrieved, and the Empire's analyst [[Geg Winthazen]] was able to use it to find the Rebels' weapon site. On Thrawn's orders, the Rebel installation was wiped out. Maximilian Veers was in charge of cleaning up after Thrawn, eliminating any survivors of the destroyed cell.<ref name="SWG:CT" /> After finding a shipment of guns that had been stolen off the shuttle, Veers had the mastermind of the attacks, a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] named [[Borvo (Twi'lek)|Borvo]], killed, sending AT-ATs to his base to finish the job.<ref name="SWG:CV" /> The plans for the retreat fell into the Rebel's hands that year as well. Disguised as the poetry of a Rebel contact named [[Nura Tinall]], the plans were delivered to [[Ebenn Q3 Baobab/Legends|Ebenn Q3 Baobab]] of Naboo. Baobab hired an intermediary in Moenia to pass the plans to Tinall, under the guise of returning her poetry, and Tinall in turn intended to deliver them to Rebel leader [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]].<ref name="SWG:EQB" />

[[File:Retreat_Tower.jpg|thumb|right|220px|One of the retreat's many guard towers.]]

Desiring to make a point of the Empire's commitment to destroying the Rebellion, Palpatine hired a band of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to attack the summer home of [[Kylantha]], [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen of Naboo]], in the guise of Rebels. After meeting with Kylantha at the retreat, the Emperor ordered the mock-Rebels crushed as a demonstration of what it meant to defy the Empire and Queen, then had his message delivered directly to Naboo's [[Parliament]].<ref name="SWG:TE" /> The [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] later visited the retreat to pass off information to Vader; the Dark Lord was busy investigating the connection between [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and the pilot who destroyed the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], a quest he would continue to be consumed with.<ref name="SWG:DV" /> At the retreat, Vader also met with an agent of the Empire, [[Finn Darktrin]], after the latter failed to retrieve a [[Datacron/Legends|data holocron]] containing a list of high ranking Rebel sympathizers.<ref name="TRoD" />

The Empire's problems did not abate after the Emperor's demonstration. Palpatine suspected Kylantha was harboring a Rebel [[General/Legends|general]]; an investigation was launched that proved the Emperor correct, and the man, [[Jacen Nire]], was located and killed.<ref name="SWG:TEatQ">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Imperial|The Emperor and the Queen|Naboo}}</ref> Meanwhile, Kaja Or'Zee launched an investigation into Rebel infiltration of the retreat. The facility's guard towers had been entered without authorization, an AT-ST had been found with a [[Jammer/Legends|jamming device]] on it, and even the landing gear of the Emperor's shuttle had been tampered with. The culprit was eventually fingered as Major [[Barret Herand]], and the major and his associates were killed for their [[Treason/Legends|treason]].<ref name="SWG:IS" /> After sending a fake message from the retreat, supposedly from Herand calling for extraction, the Imperials were able to take out Herand's Rebel handlers as well.<ref name="SWG:TSH">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Imperial|The Spy's Handler|Naboo}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Emperor's Retreat first appeared as a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ER" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

In the game, the Emperor's Retreat served as the starting point for numerous quests dedicated to Imperial-aligned players. Many of the characters mentioned in this article were [[Wikipedia:non-player character|non-player characters]] (NPCs) who assigned such quests. The most iconic NPCs, including Palpatine, Vader, Thrawn, Veers, and Hethrir, gave a number of interconnected quests, collectively termed the "[[W:c:swg:Imperial Theme Park (pre-CU)|Imperial Theme Park]]."<ref name="Serving" /> In its original version, the "Imperial Theme Park" consisted of different quests with poor game mechanics, all of them with endpoints randomly-generated close to the Retreat.<ref name="SWG:KO" /><ref name="SWG:TE" /><ref name="SWG:DV" /><ref name="SWG:CT" /><ref name="SWG:CV" /><ref name="SWG:LHPoJ" /> An NPC named Wurson Harro appeared in the retreat as well; his sole purpose was to reset the questline.<ref name="SWG:WH" /> The "Imperial Theme Park" was completely [[W:c:swg:Imperial Theme Park|revamped]] upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Update Notes 6.12: September 13 2007|Chapter 6.12]]" update, on [[September 13]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67417&month=092007|text=Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild}}</ref> The questgiver NPCs remained the same but the story changed and the quest gameplay was extensively modernized.<ref name="Serving" /> Other NPC of note present at the Emperor's Retreat were the Inquisitors. These NPCs were Imperial "pilot trainers" who provided space missions to pilots who had joined the Imperial Inquisition squadron. These Inquisitors were added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:II" /> 

The [[Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|''Champions of the Force'']] installment of ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'' shows a rather different rendition of the retreat than ''Galaxies''. It is likely ''Galaxies''{{'}} simplified rendition is a matter of game mechanics.<ref name="SWG:ER" /> <ref name="TCG" />
